description: This file contains functions and data structures for synchronizing shared channels and users across remote clusters in Mattermost, including sending sync messages, handling errors, and managing batch synchronization of users and posts.

classes.name: syncData
classes.description: Data structure holding all information needed for synchronizing a shared channel or user batch, including posts, reactions, users, attachments, and cursor info.

classes.name: attachment
classes.description: Represents a file attachment associated with a post for synchronization.

methods.name: newSyncData
methods.description: Initializes a new syncData object with provided task, remote cluster, and shared channel remote info.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the syncData object has no data to sync.

methods.name: isCursorChanged
methods.description: Determines if the cursor has changed since the last sync, indicating new data to fetch.

methods.name: setDataFromMsg
methods.description: Populates syncData fields from a given SyncMsg.

methods.name: syncForRemote
methods.description: Main function to synchronize a remote cluster with new posts, reactions, users, and other data for a specific channel or globally.

methods.name: fetchUsersForSync
methods.description: Fetches users who have updated their profiles or images since the last sync.

methods.name: fetchPostsForSync
methods.description: Fetches new or updated posts since the last sync cursor.

methods.name: appendPosts
methods.description: Appends posts to a destination slice, ensuring root posts are included if needed.

methods.name: containsPost
methods.description: Checks if a post is already in a list.

methods.name: fetchReactionsForSync
methods.description: Fetches reactions for posts since the last sync.

methods.name: fetchAcknowledgementsForSync
methods.description: Fetches acknowledgements for posts since the last sync.

methods.name: fetchPostUsersForSync
methods.description: Fetches all users associated with posts, including mentions and reactions.

methods.name: fetchPostAttachmentsForSync
methods.description: Fetches file attachments for posts.

methods.name: filterPostsForSync
methods.description: Filters out posts that do not need to be synchronized based on criteria like edits, deletions, or origin.

methods.name: sendSyncData
methods.description: Sends collected sync data (users, posts, reactions, etc.) to the remote cluster.

methods.name: sendUserSyncData
methods.description: Sends user update data to remote cluster and updates last sync timestamps.

methods.name: sendAttachmentSyncData
methods.description: Sends post attachments to remote cluster.

methods.name: sendPostSyncData
methods.description: Sends posts and mention transforms to remote cluster.

methods.name: sendReactionSyncData
methods.description: Sends reactions to remote cluster.

methods.name: sendAcknowledgementSyncData
methods.description: Sends acknowledgements to remote cluster.

methods.name: sendStatusSyncData
methods.description: Sends status updates to remote cluster.

methods.name: sendProfileImageSyncData
methods.description: Sends user profile images to remote cluster.

methods.name: shouldUserSyncGlobal
methods.description: Determines if a user needs to be globally synchronized based on update timestamps.

methods.name: syncAllUsers
methods.description: Synchronizes all local users to a remote cluster, using cursor-based pagination.

methods.name: getGlobalUserSyncBatchSize
methods.description: Returns the configured batch size for global user synchronization.

methods.name: collectUsersForGlobalSync
methods.description: Collects users that need to be synchronized, respecting batch size and last sync timestamp.

methods.name: updateGlobalSyncCursor
methods.description: Updates the remote cluster's last global user sync timestamp.

methods.name: scheduleNextUserSyncBatch
methods.description: Schedules the next batch of user sync tasks.

methods.name: sendSyncMsgToRemote
methods.description: Sends a sync message to a remote cluster, handling plugin or direct remote cluster communication.

methods.name: sendSyncMsgToPlugin
methods.description: Sends a sync message to a plugin implementation.

methods.name: sanitizeSyncData
methods.description: Sanitizes user data before sending to remote clusters.

methods.name: handleChannelNotSharedError
methods.description: Handles errors when a remote indicates a channel is no longer shared, unsharing it locally and notifying users.
